election.head: Okonjo-Vale fires you on her first morning.

lines: LOST: Tommy Rourke (President, Port Carrick Police Benevolent Association). The union turns on you: department morale settles at 45 instead of 60.
LOST: Marguerite Duff (Councillor, chair of the budget committee). The budget committee cuts the department's allocation by 8%.
LOST: Rev. Alma Mbeki-Shaw (Carrick Community Coalition). The coalition tells its groups to stop talking to you: no community tips in any ward.
LOST: Paul Varga (District Attorney). The DA's office reviews every case you clear: with evidence behind it, the officer is charged.
Election day. Dana Okonjo-Vale wins with 54%.
